title.zh: 迁移到 TypeScript 方法论(薄)

question.zh: 把一个现有的 JavaScript 项目迁到 TypeScript,怎样才能真正迁完,又不拖垮功能开发?
question.en: How do you move an existing JavaScript project to TypeScript all the way without dragging down feature work?

claim.text.zh: 说明:这一条的数据很少。语料里明确讲迁移方法的只有一条帖子,其余多是提问和设想,所以本页只整理他明确说过的内容,不做补充。核心主张:很多迁移失败,是因为一直没上线、阻塞了功能开发,或者上线了但到处是 any。做法是先定计划,按依赖顺序推进,拆成小 PR,和功能开发交织进行。
claim.text.en: Note: there is little data for this one. Only one post in the corpus states a migration method; the rest are questions and ideas, so this page only collects what he said explicitly and adds nothing. Core claim: many migrations fail because they never ship and block feature work, or ship full of any. The way through is a plan first, progress in dependency order, small PRs, woven in with feature work.

steps.0.title.zh: 先做计划,按依赖顺序迁移
steps.0.title.en: Plan first and migrate in dependency order

steps.0.how.zh: 先理清模块之间的依赖关系,从被依赖最多的底层开始,沿着依赖链一个一个迁。这样每迁完一个文件,它的类型就能马上被上层使用。原帖只说了「按依赖逐个推进」,具体顺序是本站根据这句话做的推断。
steps.0.how.en: Map the dependencies between modules first, start from the low-level modules that most others depend on, and move up the chain one at a time, so each migrated file's types are usable by the layer above straight away. The post only says to go through the dependencies one by one; the exact order is our inference from that line.

steps.1.title.zh: 小 PR,和功能开发交织
steps.1.title.en: Small PRs woven in with feature work

steps.1.how.zh: 每次只迁一小块,单独提 PR,和正常的功能开发并行,不要搞一个长期冻结功能的大迁移分支。他提问时也列过另一种选择:用工具一次性改后缀、先用 any 兜底再慢慢清理;他没有给出明确的结论。
steps.1.how.en: Migrate one small piece at a time in its own PR, alongside normal feature work, rather than a long-running migration branch that freezes features. When asking the question he also listed the other option: rename every file at once with a tool, cover gaps with any and clean up slowly; he gave no clear verdict.

steps.2.title.zh: 别让 CI 必须全绿成为迁移的拦路虎
steps.2.title.en: Don't let an all-green CI block the migration

steps.2.how.zh: 迁移过程中,如果要求 CI 一直全绿,会让人很痛苦。他希望只拦住「PR 新引入的错误」;本站推断的做法是:对存量错误设基线,只阻止新增的错误。
steps.2.how.en: Requiring CI to stay fully green during a migration makes it painful. He wants to block only errors a PR newly introduces; our inferred approach is to set a baseline for existing errors and block only new ones.

pitfalls.0.text.zh: 迁移一直不上线、阻塞功能开发数周,或者上线了却到处是 any。
pitfalls.0.text.en: The migration never ships and blocks feature work for weeks, or ships full of any.

pitfalls.1.text.zh: 把「CI 全绿」当作迁移成功的前提。
pitfalls.1.text.en: Treating an all-green CI as a precondition for a successful migration.

evolution.0.stance.zh: 以提问和设想为主:构想过迁移 CLI,在「一次性改后缀」和「逐文件小 PR」之间征求意见;2023-05 给出唯一一条明确的方法帖。
evolution.0.stance.en: Mostly questions and ideas: he sketched a migration CLI and asked for opinions on renaming everything at once versus small per-file PRs; in 2023-05 he posted the one clear method post.

evolution.1.stance.zh: 之后只有零星提及:如何从非 strict 迁到 strict(提问)、设想做一个 JS→TS 迁移 skill。没有新的系统性观点。
evolution.1.stance.en: After that only scattered mentions: how to move from non-strict to strict (a question), and the idea of a JS-to-TS migration skill. No new systematic view.
